title: Failed uses give feedback: a sound and a short message (no ammo, no mana, blocked with a reason); tink on too-hard blocks
player_outcome: Clicking a bow with no arrows says 'Needs Wooden Arrow' with a dry click. Casting without mana says 'Not enough mana' with a fizzle. Drinking during Potion Sickness says so. A pickaxe too weak for the block goes 'tink'. Holding the button never spams.
design: ItemUseSystem: add public event Action<PlayerEntity, ItemUseInfo, UseOutcome>? Failed and int Failures (count). Raise only when freshPress and the outcome is NoAmmo, NoMana, or Blocked with a stored reason.
Failure messages go through the existing Refused event, which Hud already toasts, so Hud.cs is untouched.
NoAmmo message: 'Needs ' + DisplayName of the lowest-Value item whose AmmoClass == item.UseAmmo. This is content-driven and cached per ammo class in a Dictionary, not a table in code.

Blocked reasons, recorded in a private _refusal set where Blocked is returned: NoItemUse -> 'You can't use items right now'; healing cooldown in Consume -> the potion_sickness buff DisplayName. Placement, boomerang-out and crystal-cap stay silent, as in Terraria.

tools/audio/sfx_recipes.py: add recipes use_fail (short dull wooden click), no_mana (descending airy fizzle) and tink (bright metallic ping). Build with /root/bpyenv/bin/python tools/audio/build_audio.py --only=use_fail,no_mana,tink and run build_audio.py --check.
SoundEvents: subscribe Failed -> Sfx.Play(outcome == NoMana ? "no_mana" : "use_fail", -4f). OnStruck: when TooHard only, play 'tink' instead of dig_* at -8 dB.
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Interaction/ItemUseSystem.cs — Failed event, Failures, raise on fresh press
tests: ItemUseTests.NoAmmoIsReportedOncePerPress: wooden_bow without arrows; Use(fresh) == NoAmmo, Failed fires once and Refused carries 'Needs Wooden Arrow'; Use(held) fires nothing
ItemUseTests.NoManaIsReported: amethyst_staff with mana 0 gives NoMana plus 'Not enough mana'
ItemUseTests.PotionSicknessExplains: drink lesser_healing_potion twice; the second fresh use gives Blocked plus the Potion Sickness message
ItemUseTests.PlacementBlockedStaysSilent: placing into an occupied cell gives Blocked with no Failed event

combat.cmds: 'clear' / 'give wooden_bow 1' / 'wield wooden_bow' / 'assert use.failures == 0' / 'use' / 'assert use.failures == 1' / 'hold use_primary 0.5' / 'assert use.failures == 2' (the fresh press counts once; holding adds nothing)
verification: Manual: empty-quiver clicks, a mana-less staff and a copper pickaxe on demonite all give distinct feedback with no spam while holding
risks: Toasts share Hud's six-line stack with pickup toasts until the UI phase adds Terraria pop-ups.
The ammo-name lookup must skip placeholder or unobtainable items (Value 0 or the 'hidden' tag) to avoid odd names.
